name: California (Labor Code 510, IWC wage orders, Healthy Workplaces Healthy Families Act)
needsChecking: Not verified. Every value here was written from general knowledge of the law and must be checked against the official sources below before anyone relies on it; KeaS shows it as a suggestion until then.

overtime.note: Labor Code 510: 1.5x over 8 h in a workday, over 40 h in a workweek, and the first 8 h of the seventh consecutive day worked in a workweek; 2x over 12 h in a workday and over 8 h on that seventh day. Weekly overtime counts only hours that weren't already daily overtime. Alternative workweek schedules and exempt industries aren't handled. Needs checking.

meal.note: A 30-minute meal period before the end of the fifth hour (a second after 10 h). The premium for a missed meal period (one extra hour of pay at the regular rate per workday) isn't worked out by KeaS yet. Needs checking.

rest.note: 10 paid minutes per 4 hours or major fraction. California's premium for a missed rest break is one extra hour of pay per workday, not the 10 minutes; KeaS flags missed breaks but doesn't pay that premium yet. Needs checking.

minimumWage.note: The CA minimum wage isn't filled in yet: check this year's rate (and any city or county rate) and add it. Until then only the federal minimum is checked.

sickLeave.law: CA Healthy Workplaces, Healthy Families Act
sickLeave.capKind: hours an employer may limit use to each year
sickLeave.note: 1 hour per 30 hours worked. As amended in 2024 (SB 616): an employer may cap use at 40 hours (5 days) a year and the balance at 80 hours (10 days), or front-load 40 hours. Use may wait until the 90th day of employment. Local ordinances (for example San Francisco, Los Angeles) can require more. Needs checking.
